(a) CM3 is the first algorithm that learns both individual goal attainment for each agent and cooperation for others’ success, (b) CM3 uses a novel two-stage learning curriculum, in which agents first learn to reach their own goal, and only then learn to coordinate with others, and (c) CM3 learns significantly faster than other algorithms, including those that have been designed specifically for the multi-goal multi-agent domain.

(1) CM3 is a multi-goal multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture that learns significantly faster than existing algorithms; (2) CM3 is the first multi-goal multi-agent algorithm to use a two-stage curriculum to learn single-agent goal attainment and multi-agent cooperation; (3) CM3 uses a function augmentation scheme and a credit function to bridge value and action functions across the curriculum; and (4) CM3 learns significantly faster than baselines on three multi-goal multi-agent benchmarks.
